texts.title: 课文一：买杯子
texts.setting: 在一家小店，王一雪在买杯子。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.english: Excuse me, do you have any cups?

lines.speaker: 售货员
lines.english: Yes, the cups are over here.

lines.speaker: 售货员
lines.hanzi: 这些五块钱一个，那些十块钱一个。
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē wǔ kuài qián yí gè, nàxiē shí kuài qián yí gè.
lines.english: These are five yuan each, and those are ten yuan each.

texts.title: 课文二：买苹果
texts.setting: 在菜市场，王一雪在买水果。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.pinyin: Zhèr de shuǐguǒ zhēn bù shǎo!

lines.speaker: 售货员
lines.english: What would you like to buy?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng jīn píngguǒ.
lines.english: I'd like two jin of apples, please.

lines.speaker: 售货员
lines.hanzi: 苹果三块五一斤。这些七块二，七块钱吧。
lines.pinyin: Píngguǒ sān kuài wǔ yì jīn. Zhèxiē qī kuài èr, qī kuài qián ba.
lines.english: The apples are 3.5 yuan per jin. That's 7.2 yuan in total; let's make it 7 yuan.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 好的，这儿的苹果真便宜！
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, zhèr de píngguǒ zhēn piányi!
lines.english: Great! The apples here are really affordable!

texts.title: 课文三：买衣服
texts.setting: 在商场里，刘明和王一雪在给孩子买衣服。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 这家商店衣服真多！这件一百元，怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn yīfu zhēn duō! Zhè jiàn yìbǎi yuán, zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: There are so many clothes in this store! This one is 100 yuan. What do you think?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.english: It looks good, and it is not expensive.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.pinyin: Xiǎoxuě néng chuān, mǎi yí jiàn ba.
lines.english: Xiaoxue can wear it. Let's buy one.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Xiǎomíng néng chuān ma?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 不能。这些是女孩子穿的衣服，男孩子的衣服在那儿。
lines.pinyin: Bù néng. Zhèxiē shì nǚ háizi chuān de yīfu, nán háizi de yīfu zài nàr.
lines.english: No. These are girls' clothes. Boys' clothes are over there.

g_l10_01.english: Use 块 or 元 to talk about RMB amounts. In spoken Chinese, 块 is common; 钱 can be added after the amount. 三块五 means three yuan and five jiao.
g_l10_01.russian: Для цены в юанях используются 块 или 元. В разговорной речи чаще говорят 块; после суммы можно добавить 钱. 三块五 означает 3 юаня 5 цзяо.

g_l10_02.structure: 主语 + 程度副词/否定副词 + 形容词
g_l10_02.english: In Chinese, an adjective can work as the predicate without 是. A degree word such as 很, 真, 太, or a negative word such as 不 often appears before the adjective.
g_l10_02.russian: В китайском языке прилагательное может быть сказуемым без 是. Перед прилагательным часто ставятся 很, 真, 太 или отрицание 不.

data.passage: 这儿的水果真不少！您想买什么？我想买两斤苹果。苹果三块五一斤。这些七块二，七块钱吧。好的，这儿的苹果真便宜！
data.passage_pinyin: Zhèr de shuǐguǒ zhēn bù shǎo! Nín xiǎng mǎi shénme? Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng jīn píngguǒ. Píngguǒ sān kuài wǔ yì jīn. Zhèxiē qī kuài èr, qī kuài qián ba. Hǎo de, zhèr de píngguǒ zhēn piányi!

data.title: 课文三：买衣服
data.passage: 这家商店衣服真多！这件一百元，怎么样？好看，也不贵。小雪能穿，买一件吧。好的。小明能穿吗？不能。这些是女孩子穿的衣服，男孩子的衣服在那儿。好的。
data.passage_pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn yīfu zhēn duō! Zhè jiàn yìbǎi yuán, zěnmeyàng? Hǎokàn, yě bú guì. Xiǎoxuě néng chuān, mǎi yí jiàn ba. Hǎo de. Xiǎomíng néng chuān ma? Bù néng. Zhèxiē shì nǚ háizi chuān de yīfu, nán háizi de yīfu zài nàr. Hǎo de.

questions.question_cn: 刘明觉得这件衣服怎么样？
questions.question_pinyin: Liú Míng juéde zhè jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng?
Nán háizi de yīfu zài nǎr?
